title: feat(app-shell)!: retire the separate Installed Apps view (objectui#12733)
body:
Fixes #12733
Clause-②: no (narrowing)

Retires the separate Installed Apps view (ruling B on objectstack#23892, record `6216295104`, item 2: "the separate Installed Apps view retires once the filtered view serves its actions"). Setup → Packages filtered to Marketplace has been the one installed list since objectui#12675, and objectstack#23933 (state `completed`) points the install-local plugin's Installed Apps entry straight at it. Retired immediately, with no staged window, as the card rules. It narrows three published surfaces (an export, a registered widget, routes), so it owes one `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review.

## What changed

- Deleted `packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/InstalledListWidget.tsx` (the `marketplace:installed-list` registration and its `app-shell:` twin) and `MarketplaceInstalledPage.tsx`.
- `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts`: the `MarketplaceInstalledPage` export and the widget's side-effect import are gone. `packages/app-shell/package.json`: the widget's two `sideEffects` entries (dist and src) are gone.
- `AppContent.tsx`: the lazy declaration and both `system/marketplace/installed` routes (no-active-app branch and app branch) are gone. `appRouteMetadataReads.ts`: that route's row is gone. The table and the routes stay equal both ways (`appRouteMetadataReads-12809.test.ts`).
- `MarketplacePage.tsx`: the "Installed (N)" button calls `navigate(packagesHref(basePath || '/apps/setup', 'marketplace'))`. `packagesHref` (`views/metadata-admin/packageSource.ts`) is the one URL builder the retired redirect used, so no second builder is added. The base is the page's own `basePath`, computed from `useParams().appName`. The `/apps/setup` fallback is the retired redirect's own no-app-segment choice, moved here unchanged: the button lands where the redirect used to send it, minus the hop.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/known-schema-types.ts`: regenerated with `node scripts/regenerate-known-schema-types.mjs`, not hand-edited. The generator dropped exactly the two keys.
- `apps/console/vite.config.ts`: the `app-shell-eager-leaves` regex loses its `InstalledListWidget.tsx` alternative. With the file deleted, the alternative matched nothing. The group keeps the `SuggestedBindingsPanel` pair, and its comment is rewritten so it no longer names the retired files.
- `.changeset/12733-retire-installed-apps-view.md`: `minor` for `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/cli`, never `major`, per AGENTS.md's version policy. It states the breaking semantics, FROM → TO for each retired name, and the one-line fix.

## Readers: flipped, deleted or edited

| Reader | Action | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `MarketplacePage.loadingStates-12710.test.tsx` (e) | edited | It pinned the button's old target. It now pins `/apps/setup/component/developer/packages?source=marketplace`, the no-app case. |
| same file, new (f) | added | The app-segment case: with `appName: 'crm'` the button opens `/apps/crm/component/developer/packages?source=marketplace`. |
| `PackagesPage.source-12675.test.tsx`, describe "The Installed Apps entries open Packages filtered…" | deleted | Its only subjects were the retired widget and the retired route. The header bullet and the now-unused imports went with it. |
| `AppContent.pseudoRouteSegments.test.tsx`, the `/apps/ghost/system/marketplace/installed` row and its mock | deleted | The row's subject is a retired route. The `acme.crm` row still covers `system/marketplace/:packageId`, and the route-reads parity pins the table against the routes. |
| `AppContent.systemHubRoutes`, `orphanedPageComponentRefs-10520`, `ApiConsolePage.requestPreset-10591` | edited | Each one only stubbed the deleted module with `vi.mock`, and the stub went with the module. |
| `registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`, `UNJUDGED_SPEC_BLOCKS['marketplace:installed-list']` | edited, NOT deleted | See "Residual names" below. The reason stays `EMPTY SPEC SHAPE`, the class the ledger's rot check derives mechanically, and its prose now says the type is not registered here since objectui#12733. |
| `check-installed-spec-pin-claims.test.ts`, REFUSAL 1 control | re-pointed | It found its real line by the fragment `InstalledListWidget.tsx`. That line was rewritten, so the control now finds the same ledger line by `installedAppsPins`. That identifier also holds the letters `installed` with no word boundary, so the refusal and its firing control still test the same thing. The gate's header comment is updated to match. |
| `vite-declared-lazy-views.test.ts` | edited | AppContent now declares 11 distinct lazy modules, down from 12, and the retired page's `toContain` is gone. The script's header table and prose no longer name the retired files, and its dated measurements are kept. |
| `registered-types-validate-ratchet-10859.test.ts` | pin lowered 306 → 304 | See the next section. |

## Outside the claim's file surface (declared)

- `packages/cli/src/__tests__/registered-types-validate-ratchet-10859.test.ts`. This ratchet reads the regenerated known-types list. After the regeneration it measured 304 refused namespaced keys against its pin of 306. Its own failure text says: "Fewer than the pin — an arm landed. LOWER `NAMESPACED_REFUSED_AT_TYPE` to 304 in this same change". The two keys are exactly the retired widget's pair, so the edit is one number plus one history clause. It is a reader of `known-schema-types.ts`, the family the dispatch asked to be run.
- `apps/console/src/pages/developer/ApiConsolePage.requestPreset-10591.test.tsx` is one of "the tests that name them", though the claim's parenthetical list does not spell it out. Its only change is the deleted mock.

## Residual names (done-when, measured)

The card's done-when bans the three names everywhere in objectui. After this PR, `git grep` outside `CHANGELOG.md` still finds three lines:

- `apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`, the ledger key `'marketplace:installed-list'`, and one dated census comment ("42 -> 45 on the 17.3.0 pin"). These cannot go while the installed `@objectstack/spec` carries the row. The test requires the ledger to partition `Object.keys(ComponentPropsMap)` exactly, so deleting the entry turns "accounts for every spec-carried block" red. The built console confirms the row is still there: the only built asset holding the string `marketplace:installed-list` is `vendor-objectstack-*.js`, which is the bundled spec. The entry leaves when the spec retires the type (see Acceptance notes).
- `.changeset/12675-packages-source.md`. This is objectui#12675's pending release text, outside the claim's file surface. `check-installed-spec-pin-claims.mjs` treats pending changesets as dated records, exactly as it treats `CHANGELOG.md`, and both releasing together reads as accurate history: the redirect first, then its retirement.
- `CHANGELOG.md` files are kept as ruled.

## Measurements (the dispatch's mechanism assumptions)

1. Reader enumeration was re-taken on `bc281f4a1` with `git grep`. It matched the PM's list, plus `.changeset/12675-packages-source.md` and the CHANGELOGs. Control: `MarketplacePage` hits `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` once.
2. The page takes APP from `useParams().appName` (`basePath = appName ? /apps/APP : ''`). The redirect took it the same way with the `/apps/setup` fallback, and it built the URL with `packagesHref`. Both are reused, and no second builder is added.
3. See the readers table.
4. objectstack `b9ac35cbf` was read only. `packages/cli/test/platform-page-i18n-parity.test.ts` uses a synthetic `SAMPLE_PAGE` fixture. `packages/lint/src/validate-component-props.test.ts` and `validate-component-types.test.ts` use local stack fixtures judged against `@objectstack/spec`'s own `ComponentPropsMap` and vocabulary. None of them reads objectui's built registry. The one objectstack artefact derived from objectui's built registry, `sdui.manifest.json` (from `getPublicConfigs()` at `.objectui-sha`), does not carry `marketplace:installed-list` today. Its positive control `object-grid` is present, so the next `.objectui-sha` bump does not move it for this key. objectstack's served pages no longer reference the widget: `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-ui.ts` says "The bundle carries no page", and only tests name the type there.
5. The regex alternative matched nothing once the file was gone, so it is dropped. `check:eager-closure` and `check:docs-route-closure` stay green with no budget or ceiling edited. This branch's console build reads an eager closure of 3153.0 KB gzipped across 75 eager chunks. The delta against main was NOT MEASURED: no base build was made, and CI's run is the base reading.

## Verification (union at `3aacb6e1c`, the final commit)

- Build: `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build` passed, and so did `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/console^...' build && pnpm --filter @object-ui/console build`. The `declared-lazy-views` plugin printed "10/11 modules AppContent declares lazy are genuinely lazy; 1 eager, all pinned".
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsconfig.test.json`) and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/cli type-check` passed.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/ packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage.source-12675.test.tsx`: 170 files, 1240 tests passed.
- `pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/src/__tests__/ apps/console/src/pages/developer/ApiConsolePage.requestPreset-10591.test.tsx`: 61 files, 926 tests passed.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/cli/src/__tests__/` plus the three script tests: 32 files, 484 tests passed. The other readers of `known-schema-types.ts` (schema-catalog, plugin-report, types, two more script tests) passed in the earlier run.
- Those two app-shell/console runs were at `9906076`. The only commit after it changes one cli test, which the cli run above covered.
- Gates, all exit 0: `check:side-effects-array`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:sdui-registration-pins` ("All 15 registration(s) a `sideEffects` array promises are present in the built console"), `check:readme-exports`, `check:registry-bare-names`, `check:component-surface-parity`, `check:installed-pin-claims`, `check:eager-closure`, `check:docs-route-closure`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:control-bytes`, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `node scripts/regenerate-known-schema-types.mjs --check`, and `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` (NOT GOVERNED, 22 paths).
- `check:readme-exports` first answered "could not be judged" for unbuilt packages. That is a prerequisite, not a verdict, so it was re-run after the builds.
- Ablation of the one pinned behaviour change, through `ablation-replace.mjs` with a trap restore: the button was put back on `system/marketplace/installed` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `a65c3701b4bf` → `97d19d380806`). Tests (e) and (f) went red: "Tests 2 failed | 6 passed (8)". After the restore, the blob equals HEAD (`a65c3701b4bf`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- Lint on the changed files: 0 errors. The 45 warnings are on unchanged lines. The repo-wide lint scan belongs to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- **Old bookmarks.** With no staged window, `/apps/APP/system/marketplace/installed` now matches `system/marketplace/:packageId`, so it opens the package page for an id `installed`, which the catalog does not have. The changeset states this and gives the fix (link to the filtered Packages URL).
- **Spec seam, for the seat to file upstream.** `@objectstack/spec` still declares the type: its `ComponentPropsMap` row (an empty strict shape), the component-type vocabulary and `page.zod.ts`'s console-widget list. objectstack's lint keeps accepting a page that names it (its `validate-component-types` test "accepts marketplace:installed-list", and `validate-component-props` "stays silent on the empty bag"). After this PR, objectui draws the unknown-component panel for that node, and `objectui check` no longer counts the type as known.
  - `Seam: spec:ComponentPropsMap['marketplace:installed-list'] → renderer: none (registration retired by objectui#12733)`
  - Precedent for the upstream shape: `record:json`, filed for spec retirement as objectstack#24162.
- **Ordering for the cloud seat** (from triage `6239084466`): cloud's `.objectui-sha` should not pass this merge before its `.objectstack-sha` carries objectstack#23933's merge.
- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer). It removes one.
